src/event-buffer.ts.name: Recent events and delivery
src/event-buffer.ts.description: Keeps a ring of recent nostr events and delivers matching ones to each napplet's open subscriptions.

src/relay-handler.ts.name: Relay request handler
src/relay-handler.ts.description: Handles a napplet's relay subscribe, query and publish requests: plans relays, gets approval, signs, encrypts and sends.

src/relay-result.ts.name: Relay read results
src/relay-result.ts.description: Packages a nostr event with optional extra details, such as which relays it came from, for read replies.

src/replay.ts.name: Duplicate event guard
src/replay.ts.description: Rejects events already seen or stamped too far outside the allowed time window.
